description: The Warp app from Warp's .deb or .rpm, found through the package name.
why: Nothing from Warp's Agent CLI is installed here, so the deb or rpm row is Warp's only witness and removing the value turns must_find red.
known_gaps: The AppImage and the pacman package are not installed; an AppImage registers no package, so it is reachable only once run.
